title: From research questions
to answers in the physical world.
about.deck: Omega Insights is a space for technical perspectives and discussion from BAAI-Humanoid.

sections.title: Our focus
paragraphs: As outlined on our GitHub organization page, we focus on whole-body mobile manipulation for humanoid robots: coordinated locomotion and manipulation, contact-rich control, bimanual and dexterous skills, teleoperation and data, and sim-to-real deployment.
We examine publicly described technical approaches, system design trade-offs, and questions that deserve further experiments.

sections.title: Reading these articles
paragraphs: We aim to distinguish public technical facts, results reported by companies, and our own judgments. Numerical results should be read in the context of the original tasks, data, and evaluation protocols. Demonstrations from different companies do not form a common leaderboard.
Articles include references, their scope, and the date sources were checked. Git preserves a revision history as new evidence leads to updates.

sections.title: References and corrections
paragraphs: Each technical essay includes Markdown, BibTeX, and structured reference downloads. BibTeX entries cite the original sources, preserving the distinction between web publications and research papers.
We welcome corrections in the site repository and additions supported by sources.
